_comment: Same theseus transfer as text_rebase_t5base_t5large_theseus_hubcheckpoint.json, but the target head is not built from a nearest-mean-cosine file: 'linear_probe_head' trains it from scratch, post-transport, on the exact same support set (method_params.shots_per_class examples per class, same seed) used to calibrate theseus's own activation alignment. No target_task_heads/build_nearest_mean_head.py step needed -- do NOT set target_task_heads alongside linear_probe_head, they're mutually exclusive.
_source_base_UNVERIFIED: source_model_name_or_path is set to google-t5/t5-base (the original T5, NOT google/t5-v1_1-base) because varun-v-rao/t5-base-snli's model name implies it was fine-tuned from classic t5-base.
_source_input_template: varun-v-rao/t5-base-snli was fine-tuned on a single formatted string, not this repo's default tokenizer(premise, hypothesis) pair encoding -- confirmed with scripts/probe_nli_input_format.py. A-only: B (t5-v1_1-large) still uses the default pair encoding.
